channel.title: Violations Watch: Sudan
channel.description: New incidents reported in Sudan. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Drone attack in Sudan's West Kordofan kills at least 11 people, a medical source says (Arab News)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). West Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Killing of civilians. Reported casualties: 11+ killed. Disputed or caveats: Attribution not stated; residents of El Nuhud report daily drone strikes as the army advances. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2391

item.title: Army-affiliated security unit in Ed Damazin, Blue Nile State, detains civil society volunteers and other civilians without charge; Emergency Lawyers report five arbitrary arrests and a resident has been missing for 16 days (Radio Tamazuj, Sudan Tribune)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Ed Damazin, Blue Nile, Sudan. Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Army-affiliated security cell (Sudanese Armed Forces). 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2371

item.title: Drone strike on a family home in Omdurman, Sudan, on 22 Nov kills a 10-year-old boy as he prepared for school and injures his infant cousin, NRC says
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Omdurman, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Reported casualties: 1 killed, 1 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: No party named as responsible. 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2222

item.title: RSF drone strikes on Ed Damazin and another town in Blue Nile State, Sudan, late on 24 Nov kill at least 14 civilians and wound 15, many of them children, according to local civil society and medical sources
item.description: Unverified lead (Critical priority). Ed Damazin, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Reported casualties: 14-19 killed, 15-25 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Tolls vary: 14 (local civil society and medical sources), 17 (UN), 19 (rights group via Reuters/Radio Tamazuj). 10 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2039

item.title: Farmer–herder clashes in East Darfur leave five dead and six injured (Radio Tamazuj)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Farmers and herders (communal clash). Reported casualties: 5 killed, 6 injured. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2035

item.title: SIHA reports RSF fighters and allied militia abducted 28 underage girls and women while fleeing Blue Nile fighting, and conflict-related sexual violence against girls
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Blue Nile, Sudan. Types: Sexual & gender-based violence, Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: RSF and allied militia. Grave violations against children: Abduction, Rape and other sexual violence. Disputed or caveats: Reports received by SIHA; numbers not broken down by age. 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1886

item.title: Sheikh detained in El Obeid, North Kordofan, found dead in custody (Radio Dabanga)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). El Obeid, North Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Detaining authority (not stated). Reported casualties: 1 killed. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1889

item.title: RSF accused of executing captured Sudanese army soldiers in Blue Nile State (Radio Dabanga)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Blue Nile, Sudan. Types: Executions. Alleged perpetrator: Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Disputed or caveats: Accusation; RSF response not reported. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1885

item.title: A court in El Obeid sentences teacher and union activist to 10 years in prison, sparking outrage
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). El Obeid, North Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Persecution & repression, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Sudanese judiciary. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1805

item.title: Drone strikes on Khartoum and Omdurman on 22 Nov kill at least four civilians, five children according to Radio Dabanga, and damage a UN building; attacks attributed to the RSF
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Khartoum, Omdurman, Khartoum State, Sudan. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Rapid Support Forces (reported). Reported casualties: 4-5 killed, 10+ injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Tolls differ between reports (four killed per ABC; five children per Radio Dabanga). 14 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1780

item.title: RSF gunmen shoot dead three civilians in the Abu Qalb area of West Kordofan amid reported ethnically motivated attacks (Kordofan Monitor)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Abu Qalb, West Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Rapid Support Forces. Reported casualties: 3 killed. Disputed or caveats: Single rights-monitor statement. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1697

item.title: Drone strike on Kaja and Katcha villages, Buram locality, South Kordofan, on 19 Nov kills seven civilians and injures 14, local activists say; they attribute it to the Sudanese Armed Forces
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Buram, South Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Sudanese Armed Forces (alleged). Reported casualties: 7 killed, 14 injured. Disputed or caveats: Attribution to the SAF by local activists. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1416

item.title: Fighting between the RSF and Joint Forces in Kernoi, North Darfur, on 19 Nov kills three civilians, injures 15 and displaces 75 families
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Kernoi, North Darfur, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Forced displacement. Alleged perpetrator: Rapid Support Forces and Joint Forces of Armed Struggle Movements. Reported casualties: 3 killed, 15 injured. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1417

item.title: Landmine blast kills 18 members of one family travelling from Um Arda, West Kordofan, to El Obeid on 19 Nov
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Um Arda, West Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Unknown (landmine). Reported casualties: 18 killed. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1418

item.title: Drone strike on the Bajoun gold mining site, Gadeer locality, South Kordofan, on 18 Nov kills at least 10 people and injures others (Radio Dabanga)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Bajoun mining site, Gadeer locality, South Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Unattributed drone strike (an X aggregator attributes it to the RSF). Reported casualties: 10 killed. Disputed or caveats: Attribution not established. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1365

item.title: Drone strike on a school sheltering displaced people in Ghubaish, West Kordofan, on 17 Nov kills 16 civilians and injures 10; attributed to the Sudanese army (SAF)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Ghubaish, West Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike, Attacks on education. Alleged perpetrator: Sudanese Armed Forces (reported). Reported casualties: 16 killed, 10 injured. Grave violations against children: Attacks on schools and hospitals. Disputed or caveats: Attribution to SAF from activists and initial X reports; figures from local sources (Radio Tamazuj). 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1180

item.title: Drone strike attributed to the Sudanese army hits a football field in Abu Qalb, Abu Zabad locality, West Kordofan: 13–15 civilians killed, including four children (Kordofan Human Rights Observatory)
item.description: Unverified lead (Critical priority). Abu Qalb, Abu Zabad, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Sudanese Armed Forces (attributed). Reported casualties: 13-30 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Toll rose from 13–15 to 30 per Radio Dabanga and Emergency Lawyers; attribution to the Sudanese army from monitors. 7 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0912

item.title: Indiscriminate gunfire, including anti-aircraft weapons, in El Obeid, North Kordofan: one killed and more than 45 injured
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). El Obeid, North Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Not stated. Reported casualties: 1 killed, 45+ injured. Disputed or caveats: Shooters not identified in the report. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0753

item.title: RSF reported to have killed 10 civilians in a West Kordofan town, according to a Sudanese relief group
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). West Kordofan, Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Reported casualties: 10 killed. item.title: INGOs warn October was one of the deadliest months for civilians from drone strikes in Sudan, citing a strike on Um Darfa hospital

Grave violations against children: Attacks on schools and hospitals. Disputed or caveats: Aggregate NGO statement; individual incidents not detailed in the summary. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0656
